Done.

## Stage 8 — Interpretability + perf restore

**Sidebar groupings**: catalog/workspace/trace/audit labels back, quiet 10px uppercase tracked, only show when expanded; hairline dividers when collapsed. Stage-7 polish preserved.

**Diff view**: new `DiffView.tsx` (deps: `diff` + `@types/diff`). Green/red unified diff with line numbers. Wired into Runs SlideOver, Memories Changes, Reviews `large_diff`.

**MemoryInspector**: new component shows full body, type/status/confidence chips, metadata grid, lineage with clickable navigation. Wired into Reviews (with approve/suppress/stale actions in header), Memories Surface/Explorer, Runs (memory ops), Retrievals (candidates), Graph (clickNode).

**Reviews fix**: item ID is now clickable IdLink → MemoryInspector. Background prefetch populates 80-char preview column.

**Perf root cause**: backend was never slow (3-29ms across all endpoints). The 5-10s came from `createResource` re-firing per route mount + detail re-fetch per SlideOver open + no shared cache. Fixed via:
- `lib/cache.ts` — keyed cache with TTL (15-60s) + in-flight dedup + prefix invalidate
- Hover prefetch on Runs/Memories/Retrievals rows (warm cache before click)
- All list + detail resources cached
- Result: cached nav serves from memory, click→inspector instant

**Opaque ID sweep**: every hash ID across 12 routes is now clickable IdLink with hover tooltip + truncate-middle (`mem_a3f4…7b24`).

**Gates**: tsc 0, pnpm build 426KB / 124KB gz, make lint clean, make test 368 pass.

**Caveats noted**: Reviews preview prefetch is best-effort (trailing rows ID-only until inspector opens); graph non-memory nodes show fallback card; sessions timeline payload is `<pre>` expandable (not per-kind structured render). All flagged as follow-ups.

Server live on `:8765`.
